summary: The code runs and is syntactically valid with appropriate imports and a working main() call at global scope. It implements a simplified agent-based adoption simulation with peer influence, media, policy enforcement, purchasing, mobility, and an optional SEIR-lite module. However, it does not conform to the specified Mask Adoption Dynamics schema: key entities (Household, PolicyAuthority, InformationSource, MaskMarket with types), attributes, interactions, parameters, and several required metrics and validation checks are missing or only partially implemented.

issues.description: Entity model does not match specification. Missing classes/attributes: Household (with norms), PolicyAuthority (with policy_schedule), InformationSource (credibility, bias, misinformation), MaskMarket with multiple mask types, prices, and supply by type. Person lacks many specified attributes (household_id, mask_type, media_consumption_profile, etc.).
issues.location: Classes Person, Government, Media, Retailer; missing Household, PolicyAuthority, InformationSource, MaskMarket
issues.solution: Refactor to include all specified entities and attributes. Implement Household norms, PolicyAuthority with policy_schedule and dynamic state, InformationSource broadcasting with credibility/bias/misinformation, and MaskMarket with types_available, price_by_type, supply_level, rationing_rules.

issues.description: Required interactions are incomplete. No household_norms mechanism; information_broadcast does not model credibility or misinformation flows; purchase_masks does not model mask types or supply constraints by type.
issues.solution: Add Household influence in the daily update, implement InformationSource-based broadcasts that update risk/trust with credibility/misinformation parameters, and a MaskMarket that manages per-type stock, prices, and restocking.

issues.description: Key required metrics are missing or only partially provided: final_adoption_rate, sustained_adoption_days (consecutive days over threshold), group_adoption_gap (explicit difference by demographic groups), policy_effect_size (pre/post), compliance_in_mandated_locations (exists partially), mask_type_distribution, exposure_reduction_proxy.
issues.solution: Compute and return all metrics as specified. Add final_adoption_rate, time to 70%, sustained_adoption_days over a threshold, explicit adoption gaps by age/income, policy_effect_size using pre/post windows, compliance in mandated locations, mask type distribution over time, and an exposure_reduction_proxy based on efficacy-weighted protected contacts.

issues.description: Parameter set from specification is not used. The simulation ignores many provided parameters (mask types and efficacies, cost_by_type, supply/restock by type, policy_schedule, enforcement_level_default, etc.).
issues.solution: Wire the provided parameters into the simulation. Parse a configuration that matches the spec parameters and drive entity initializations and behaviors with those values.

issues.description: Policy scheduling and states (mandate vs recommendation) are not implemented. Government has only a fixed mandate window and does not support policy_schedule transitions.
issues.location: Government class and step() policy handling
issues.solution: Implement a PolicyAuthority with policy_schedule and state transitions (e.g., 'mandate', 'recommendation'), and vary enforcement and adoption utility effects accordingly.

issues.description: Validation criteria from the specification are not computed or enforced: convergence_check, policy_response_sanity, reproducibility verification. Adoption bounds and supply feasibility are implicitly respected, but no explicit validation outputs are produced.
issues.location: compute_metrics() or a dedicated validation function
issues.solution: Add a validation module that checks adoption bounds, convergence over last 7 days, policy response magnitude post-mandate (given enforcement and supply), supply feasibility (no negative inventories), and reproducibility (hash summary metrics for a fixed seed).

issues.description: Mask type dynamics are absent. No mask_type attribute on Person, no efficacy by type, no price differentiation or distribution metrics.
issues.location: Person, Retailer/MaskMarket, adoption and disease steps
issues.solution: Add mask_type on Person, implement purchase logic by type constrained by availability and prices, use type-specific efficacy in exposure reduction or disease module, and track mask_type_distribution over time.

issues.description: Group adoption gap is not explicitly computed across age or income groups, though per-group rates are provided and SES top-bottom gap is present.
issues.solution: Compute explicit gaps (e.g., max-min across age groups, quintile 5 minus quintile 1) and report under group_adoption_gap.

issues.description: The adoption probability model is heuristic and does not utilize provided parameters such as base_influence_strength, risk_perception_weight, policy_effect_strength, etc.
issues.solution: Parameterize the logistic model with weights from the specification to enable scenario control.

issues.description: No explicit handling for invalid CLI values (e.g., negative population size via CLI), though constructor clamps some values and parse_known_args avoids failures.
issues.solution: Add argument validation with helpful error messages and clamp or reject invalid inputs.
